title: USDOT assistant secretary visits Purdue to explore transportation cybersecurity research
summary_en: Seval Oz, assistant secretary for research and technology at the U.S. Department of Transportation (USDOT), visited Purdue University on Oct. 29 to learn about research aimed at transportation cybersecurity, autonomous transportation and infrastructure assessment.
